# Environment Variables

## Server-Side Only (FastAPI & Agent)
- `LIVEKIT_URL`: (Required) wss://...
- `LIVEKIT_API_KEY`: (Required)
- `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET`: (Required)
- `OPENAI_API_KEY`: (Required)
- `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY`: (Required)
- `DATABASE_URL`: (Required)
- `SUPABASE_URL`: (Required)
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`: (Required) - Bypass RLS for backend admin tasks.

## Browser-Safe (React Frontend)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`: (Required)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`: (Required)

*(No fake credentials are provided here, they will be generated by the user during Phase 1).*
